quality_boundary: The evidence map covers exactly three individual records from the official 108-project self-evaluation report. Each municipality rating is retained as source-reported evidence only. This file does not imply that the remaining 105 projects have been reviewed or that a circle rating is comparable with another city's evaluation scale.
